test_policy.notes: Test-optional for the 2027 term; scores are not required and not disadvantaged in admission or merit review. Policy for Fall 2028 and later is under review. Applicants answer a Common App Supplement question on whether they want scores considered.

requirements.notes: One academic teacher evaluation plus the Secondary School Report. Supplemental essay is optional (150-300 words). No in-person interviews; international applicants may submit an optional InitialView or Vericant video interview (deadlines: Nov 23 for EA/ED I, Jan 15 for ED II, Feb 16 for RD). International applicants also submit the SCU Financial Resource Statement. The deadlines page gives month and day only; the year is inferred for the fall 2027 cycle.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Deposit due May 1. Optional supplemental essay Nov 6. Web page says notification 'late December'; the exact date is from the Common Data Set.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I (binding)
deadlines.notes: Deposit and official scores due Jan 7. Optional supplemental essay Nov 6. Web page says notification 'late December'; the exact date is from the Common Data Set.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II (binding)
deadlines.notes: Deposit due Mar 1. Optional supplemental essay Jan 12. Web page says notification 'mid-February'; the exact date is from the Common Data Set.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Notification late March (no exact date published). Deposit due May 1. Optional supplemental essay Jan 12.

deadlines.label: CSS Profile / FAFSA (EA and ED I)

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exceptions: native English speakers, applicants who attended their entire secondary school career at a school taught in English, SAT EBRW 630+, or ACT 27+ on both Reading and English. College English courses do not satisfy the requirement. TOEFL MyBest, TOEFL ITP Plus and TOEFL iBT At Home are not accepted.

aid.notes: SCU is need-aware for international students and offers no need-based financial aid. International first-year students are eligible for merit scholarship consideration (except the Johnson Scholars); no separate application, all Common App applicants are considered.
